page_description: Partner with ILPlatform to organise coding, computer science and robotics activities for children, with educators, a tailored curriculum, material, and optional support for registrations, communication and subsidies.
title: Collaboration with ILPlatform
subtitle: We work with schools and organisations to offer children practical, well-structured coding, computer science and robotics activities.

needs.title: What do you need?
items: A room with plugs and WiFi
A secure location to store the material

optional.title: Optional support
optional.content: If needed, we can also offer additional help to make organising and running the activities easier.

items.title: Registration system
items.content: If useful for your school or organisation, registrations can go through our website.

items.title: Communication
items.content: We can help promote the joint activities to families and local communities.

items.title: Subsidy applications
items.content: We can support schools with subsidy applications to help reduce the cost for parents.

programme.title: Specially Designed Programme
programme.content: Our programme is built around age-adapted coding, computer science and robotics activities, with projects designed to develop logical thinking, creativity and confidence with technology.

schools.title: Schools already working with us
schools.content: We already work with many schools in Brussels. Do you want to be the next one?
schools.map_fallback: The partner school map needs a Google Maps JavaScript API key before it can show multiple custom pins.
